reviewer_scope: R3 section 2.2 D0013 direct and indirect outcome information paths
purpose: Execute a source-rebuilt strict-input reference and audit prohibited paths; do not certify original laboratory models leakage-free.
new_predictors: age at earliest dated source observation in China or admission in MIMIC
recorded sex at that same observation or source patient registry
population: Existing native cohort and original diagnosis labels retained; complete-case source-rebuilt demographics only. Do not select by outcome or AUC.
source_rules: Do not forward-fill later observations. Conflicting same-earliest-time values and undocumented sex codes remain missing. No demographic imputation; exclude rows with either required value missing.
folds: Reuse frozen five-fold patient roles from original_v5_independent_validation_v1, restricted to eligible complete cases; test patients disjoint from all training roles.
primary_model: Same fixed 50:50 XGBoost and random forest architecture as the prior patient-isolated validation; inner-training/early-stopping roles reused. Refit outer-training only. No outer-test selection or tuning.
secondary_reference: L2 logistic C=1 with training-only standardization using the same two source-rebuilt covariates
comparisons: Previous full-input patient-isolated OOF and previous age-only OOF restricted to exact same eligible rows. Differences describe reference discrimination, not causal effects of leakage; feature construction and training populations can differ.
bootstrap_unit: patient, retaining every admission and multiplicity in a resampled patient cluster
uncertainty: Percentile 95% intervals conditional on fixed OOF predictions; no refitting uncertainty
engineering_checks: no nonfinite values in eligible inputs
one test prediction per eligible row
fit/preprocessing API accepts training arrays only
heldout label mutation leaves fitted reference unchanged
unresolved_by_design: onset and first result availability for original laboratories
clinical endpoint adjudication and complete negative capture
future-dependent original cohort selection and survivor conditioning
clinical absence of indirect disease-related signal in original models
